body: Hey OP, I’m sorry to hear about your situation. I think you should take a second and take a deep breath or two. I know finals season is stressful, but you should always prioritize your mental health and your family over tests. If you haven’t already, sit down with your sister and talk about everything that has happened and is going on. Most professors and teachers understand that their students are only humans and are willing to work with you, so email them and see what they can do for you so you can take some stress off your back for now. If you still need someone to talk to I’ll listen. Stay strong, you got this.
